quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always arranged from top to bottom as red, yellow, then green. This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
There is a dangerous curve ahead.
There is a bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you to be careful because the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and be careful as you go through.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Stop and only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be careful as you go through.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching what?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic rules you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering parking lots that are full.
Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: This sign shows what type of road feature?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: Signs with a red circle and diagonal line mean the action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns about a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: An orange sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Proceed with caution.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles and other traffic may cross.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a left turn. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending and to prepare for traffic to merge.

questions.question: This sign warns that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: You are going the wrong way.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Wait until the light turns green before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works the same as a stop sign. Stop completely at the line or before the crosswalk. Let all other traffic and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. These signs help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines can be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane. You need to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign tells drivers that a school zone or school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means no U-turns are allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and dangerous. You can lose control of your car. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers. It tells you to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield for left turns when light is green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield for left turns when light is green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to yield when turning left at a green light. You must let oncoming traffic pass first. Turn left only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road is joining from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this symbol mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Triangle signs that point downward mean you must yield. When you see a yield sign, slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they leave.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you which direction to drive when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran license plates, or disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering changes, and stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from the sides.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you about school zones and school crossings. Be alert and ready to stop when you see them.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Blue traffic signs provide information about:
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about services for drivers. They show rest areas, food, gas stations, hospitals, and other nearby services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you about school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and obey posted speed limits near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells drivers that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because the pavement will be slippery.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, the driver is signaling that they plan to stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep moving at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see one.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing marked with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for any trains and be prepared to stop if a train is coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from the right will be entering your lane.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, the driver is signaling that they plan to turn right. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop, then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Round warning signs with yellow and black markings warn about railroad crossings. This is the only use for round warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you what you must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Orange warning signs tell you about road work ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs and equipment in work zones.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first. You do not have to stop, but you must give way to other vehicles.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay on the right side of the median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A divided highway is ending ahead.
A divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is beginning ahead. Keep to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right at a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Do not cross until any trains have passed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the bridge ahead is narrow. Be careful and avoid passing trucks on this bridge.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and prepare to stop completely before going through the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let existing traffic go first.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs are rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at all in this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on a bridge above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier between them.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a Y intersection ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Watch for people entering the crosswalk or crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that traffic may enter from an upcoming side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at this intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work properly if one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could lose control by hydroplaning on water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road. If you drift off the road and one wheel drops onto the lower shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. When you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is used for work zone signs. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway from your direction. You must turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your present speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.
questions.explanation: If you are on a road with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. Move to another lane if no one is next to you.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road on a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the exact speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed for the road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians pass first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to dangerous conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is only allowed on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert you to dangerous road conditions, such as curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turn is permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
